pk.context: 10 mg oral, single dose, healthy adults

pill.desc: deep pink, film-coated, oval convex tablet

clues.kinetics: Absolute bioavailability is not known, and food does not affect it. It is 99% bound to plasma proteins, and elimination is predominantly by non-renal pathways.
clues.substance: A free carboxylic acid with a molecular weight of 378.42. It is practically insoluble in water and in solutions at low pH.
clues.product: Approved under NDA 022081 as 5 mg and 10 mg tablets, taken once daily.
clues.safety: Boxed warning for embryo-fetal toxicity. Contraindicated in pregnancy and in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis; peripheral edema and nasal congestion are common.
clues.indication: Pulmonary arterial hypertension (WHO Group 1) in adults, to improve exercise ability and delay clinical worsening, and with tadalafil to reduce progression and hospitalization.
clues.mechanism: A high-affinity antagonist of the ETA receptor, more than 4000-fold selective over ETB, blocking the vasoconstriction that ETA drives.

tell: A boxed warning for embryo-fetal toxicity and over 4000-fold selectivity for ETA over ETB set this endothelin antagonist apart.

evidence.pk.tmaxH: peak concentrations occurring approximately 2 hours after oral administration
evidence.pk.halfLifeH: Although ambrisentan has a 15-hour terminal half-life
